chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Rafa'ah and Ibn Bukayr, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), that he was asked
about Hajj, whether walking is superior or riding? He said: Rather, riding, for the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) performed Hajj riding.
ai.seo_question: Is it better to perform Hajj on foot or by riding?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes the preference for riding during Hajj by citing the Sunnah of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), who performed Hajj on a camel. This ruling highlights the Shia emphasis on emulating the Prophet’s specific practices as a primary source of legal preference, distinguishing between obligatory acts and recommended virtues.
